text.printed: Ablative Protocol — Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, flip 1 Component upgrade (Intact side) to its Destroyed side → take 2 unpreventable damage instead.

text.printed:
Setup: Put each Component upgrade (Intact side up) into play.
Action: Search your deck and discard pile for Juston Seyfert and add him to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
Action: Discard 1 card from your hand → flip each Component (Destroyed side) upgrade to its Intact side.
